title: References at the Quay
body:
## Flow

[[jorna]]'s boat waits at the quay, and [[leuchtturm]] lies dark
above the cove. No one here has asked about [[nobody]] yet.

Whoever gets too close to [[fenn]] ends up in [[smuggler-captured]].

> [!readaloud] [[jorna]] waits at the quay, in the raw text `[[jorna]]`.

The syntax itself stands as code: `[[jorna]]` stays untouched.

## If: [[jorna]] was warned

Then the boat lies empty at the quay.
